units.source_text: 地板上本可以铺三个睡铺，却只铺了两个。

en.t: There was room to lay out three bedding places on the floor, but only two had been laid out.

units.source_text: 而且，一个是千重子的睡铺。

en.t: Moreover, one of them was Chieko's bedding.

units.source_text: 看样子母亲打算和千重子同睡一个铺盖了。

en.t: It seemed that Mother intended to sleep under the same bedding as Chieko.
